thread:
oncall-alex: Heads-up — scheduling a targeted node evacuation in ap-southeast-1 tonight 02:00-03:30 UTC to apply a kernel patch. Incident-bot will kick off the drain at 02:00. Affected: Dedicated pools and Private racks in that AZ. Expect short latency blips, no expected request loss.
statuspage-bot: DRAFT status: Scheduled maintenance in ap-southeast-1. Window: 02:00–03:30 UTC. Impact: brief latency increases for inference/streaming; Dedicated customers may observe minor throughput degradation. Updates every 30m. Link: <status-draft-link>
maya: Ack. I'm pulling the pinned-cust list now — will flag any high-SLA customers. If we have >3 high-SLA impacted, propose shifting canary earlier.
ops-jordan: Ops runbook snippet:
```bash
./evacuate-nodes --region ap-southeast-1 --pool serving --grace-period 1800 --keep-fallback-per-shard 1
```
We validate KV cache warmup after each node.
oncall-alex: Handoff plan: I'm primary until 02:15 UTC, then @maya takes the pager. Escalation path: ping @ops-jordan -> DM @eng-sre-priya for rollback plan.
eng-sre-priya: Rollback TL;DR: if >5% 5xx or sustained 2x latency for >10m, trigger rollback image and restart serving pods: `--rollback-to=2026-03-05`. Approx ETA for rollback + restart ~22m.
customer-success-olivia: Draft customer note for impacted list: "We will perform scheduled maintenance in ap-southeast-1 on [DATE] 02:00–03:30 UTC. You may see brief latency increases for inference and streaming; no customer data will be lost. We'll post real-time updates on our status page: <status-link>. Reply here if you require us to avoid your dedicated pool."
maya: Small edit to CS blurb: add contact for SLA owners and a line about who to CC for opt-out requests.
oncall-alex: Good call. statuspage-bot — queue publish 45m before window?
statuspage-bot: Affirmative. Will queue at 01:15 UTC and post a 30m reminder in this thread.
incident-bot: Reminder: scheduled pager test for region at 01:45 UTC (separate event).
ops-jordan: Canary plan: patch one canary node at 01:50 -> run KV/emb pipeline smoke tests (10m). If green, proceed with rolling eviction.
eng-sre-priya: Post-maint checks: verify 95th token latency, KV hit ratio, and 5xx rate at +10m and +30m. Runbook command for quick rollback: `kubectl -n serving rollout undo deployment/serving-runtime --to-revision=3`
customer-success-olivia: I'll prepare a short template for outbound emails if any paying customers request direct notice.
maya: I'll own post-maint telemetry checks and confirm in this thread once +30m checks pass.
oncall-alex: I'll post the final completion message after I see stable metrics: "Maintenance complete. All services stable in ap-southeast-1. No customer-facing errors observed. Contact support if you see anomalies." :white_check_mark:
ops-jordan: Noting to oncall: keep `--grace-period` at 1800, but if we see backlog growth >2x we abort and open a postmortem.
oncall-alex: Thanks all — will update when status page is queued. :wave:
